evidence.reason: The current implementation still annotates createStepFetch as typeof globalThis.fetch, so its parameter accepts a native Request, but line 64 forwards that object directly to undici's fetch via an unchecked cast. Undici's RequestInfo conversion only treats its own Request class as the interface branch; a globalThis.Request fails that brand check and is converted to a USVString ('[object Request]'), discarding URL, method, headers, and body. A string or URL input is unaffected, but the declared fetch-compatible input is not honored. This is an ordinary correctness defect; no contract clause is needed. The cited line is unchanged at the pinned tip.
